findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_safety_check, solana_launch_feed · Private data: base_tx_explain, base_token_approvals, ethereum_tx_explain, ethereum_token_approvals, bsc_tx_explain, bsc_token_approvals, arbitrum_tx_explain, arbitrum_token_approvals, arbitrum_address_inspect, arbitrum_contract_risk, optimism_tx_explain, optimism_token_approvals, optimism_address_inspect, optimism_contract_risk, polygon_tx_explain, polygon_token_approvals, polygon_address_inspect, polygon_contract_risk, avalanche_tx_explain, avalanche_token_approvals, avalanche_address_inspect, avalanche_contract_risk, url_safety_check, ens_resolve, calldata_decode, wallet_portfolio, wallet_report, token_report, token_deep_scan, solana_token_check, solana_address_lookup, solana_token_delegates, launch_feed, base_launch_feed, bsc_launch_feed, solana_launch_feed · Public sink: token_deep_scan, solana_token_check.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
